answer: The quartz opens the gate, the relic pays the toll, the terrace proves the traveller waited — and waiting is the toll no printer will pay. A mask waits 14 days after paying 228 POA; a farm waits 14 days for each mask after paying 181716 POA. Proof, not promises: Jesses maker hobby proof flown at the moulting house asks for each hobby is a measured quarry yield plus a falconer's signature, and no farm can supply it honestly. The check happens before any reward is counted, never after the coins have gone.
